info.title: Uta no Prince Sama Revolutions
info.synopsis: Terza stagione di "Uta no Prince-sama: Maji Love" La commedia reverse-harem dai toni romantici segue le vicende di Nanami Haruka, una ragazza che sogna di diventare una compositrice. A tal fine si iscrive al prestigioso istituto Saotome, focalizzato sul canto, nonché sulla scoperta e promozione di talentuosi parolieri-compositori. Così Haruka sarà attorniata da fascinosi compagni di scuola, tutti bishouen idol in erba, mentre i suoi insegnati saranno personaggi di spicco dello star sistem. Tuttavia nell'accademia vige una ferrea regola: “È vietato innamorarsi!”.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Shining Agency's idol group STARISH, composer Nanami Haruka, and senior idol group QUARTET NIGHT have been making steady progress expanding their field of activity. In the entertainment world, artists and idols are beginning to enter the selection process to become the opening act of "Super Star Sports," also known as Triple S.

tvdb.title: The Dice Are Cast
tvdb.synopsis: Haruka meets the cast again after a period of not seeing each other. Shining Saotome announces that QUARTET★NIGHT will be the main act to perform in the sports event Triple S, and that Haruka will compose their song. ST☆RISH complains about this decision and decides that they'll have to prove themselves worthy by participating into a whole new project called Cross Units.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: When Shining refuses to enter STARISH in the Triple S concert, the members of STARISH trust in their potential and agree to work harder than they ever have before. Meanwhile, STARISH and NIGHT QUARTET head to a resort to film for a variety TV show.

tvdb.title: Golden Star
tvdb.synopsis: Each senior and underclassmen unit gets a variety show skit: Otoya, Tokiya and Reiji work in a daycare; Ranmaru, Masato and Ren take a stroll through town; Natsuki, Sho and Ai are confronted with a test of courage and Camus and Cecil drink some tea and try pastries at a tea shop. All the seniors show their skills leaving the juniors in admiration and thinking about how they can improve themselves. Later on, the whole cast goes to the beach.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Shining puts together the Cross-Unit Project for STARISH. The first phase features a rock musical starring Otoya and Natsuki. Though they're both overflowing with enthusiasm, they're given unexpected roles. As they dive into rehearsal to master their roles, they find their enthusiasm gets them nowhere...

tvdb.title: Emotional Life
tvdb.synopsis: Natsuki and Otoya are made into a Cross Unit and are cast as the main characters in a rock opera. Natsuki is put to play the part of a hot-headed manly guy while Otoya has to learn to be collected and cool. Both consult with their respective members (Syo and Tokiya) hoping to get some advice from them but without much luck. It is then that they both realize that they have been looking at things the wrong way and shouldn't be so worried about completely changing themselves. With the help of their friends and Haruka, they are able perform a brand new song in the play.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: When Haruka arrives at the shooting location of an upcoming film starring Ai, his costars Natsuki and Syo describe the perfection of his acting. However, Ai is unable to understand one of his lines. Given his perfect performance, the others find this statement strange. That night they discover Ai's greatest secret...

tvdb.title: Innocent Wind
tvdb.synopsis: Ai becomes the main character in a new film. He works along with Syo and Natsuki both left in awe at how perfectly he does everything, however, Ai begins to feel something has changed within him. Ai ends up overworking himself and becomes ill but refuses to rest resulting in him collapsing. Both Syo and Natsuki, along with Haruka, put Ai to rest and in the process learn that he is a robot. After explaining, the three help Ai to finish the film.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: For Cross-Unit Project phase two, Ren, Syo, and Cecil are tasked with producing a smart phone commercial. However, all three insist on their own idea and can't manage to agree. Haruka is worried about the boys, and the deadline approaches ruthlessly...

tvdb.title: Code: T.V.U
tvdb.synopsis: Syo, Ren and Cecil are made into a Cross Unit and are selected to be featured in a commercial for a mobile phone brand. Things head off to a rocky start with each member's conflicting ideas about what the theme for the commercial should be. They end up getting into a heated argument but realize that their fellow member's ideas were just as good as theirs. In the end, with help from Haruka and their friends, they are able to come up with the perfect theme for the commercial and Haruka's new song.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Haruka's new job is composing a new song for Camus, who is performing at the opening ceremony of the Shining Tower. To learn more about him, Haruka asks to accompany Camus to work, and he agrees on one condition. Will Haruka be able to write a song to satisfy Camus, who is perfect in every way...?!

tvdb.title: Saintly Territory
tvdb.synopsis: Camus is chosen as the main act in the inauguration of the Shining Tower. Haruka, hoping to learn more about Camus to write him a new song, ends up working as his assistant. Although the tasks are difficult, Haruka does not give up determined to see a side to Camus in which he can do something earnestly seeing as he always does everything perfectly but without being earnest. Haruka's feelings are able to reach Camus and he performs his new song at the inauguration.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: While working on his new solo song, Ranmaru increasingly devotes himself to his work with QUARTET NIGHT. However, Haruka and her friends sense Ranmaru is pushing himself too hard. Meanwhile, as Ranmaru gazes from a distance at the construction of the new Triple S stadium, nostalgic and bittersweet memories are on his mind...

tvdb.title: Only One
tvdb.synopsis: Ranmaru has decided to leave rock music as a way to move from his past and focus on his new life as a QUARTET★NIGHT member. Everyone opposes saying that rock is his life but he refuses to listen. Due to a past experience, Ranmaru is afraid of making the same mistakes again with his new found band members but Haruka teaches him that his love for rock and his band can be balanced without giving up on either.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Masato and Tokiya's job for the final phase of the Cross-Unit Project is performing a new song live on an influential music program. With the hopes of STARISH and the entire Shining Agency riding on their shoulders, they tell Haruka they will write the song's lyrics first. However, things don't go as well as they hoped, and they find themselves getting stuck...

tvdb.title: Original Resonance
tvdb.synopsis: Tokiya and Masato are set in a Cross Unit and work with each other in order to write lyrics for Haruka's song. Everyone thinks they are a perfect pair and look forward to their new song, but with them being the last to perform and everyone having high expectations, the pressure gets to them and they are unable to come up with any good lyrics. They try many things to be able to focus and relax but to no avail. Haruka then comes to them with some food revealing that everyone just wants them to do their best and that they are thinking about them. This gives Tokiya and Masato the encouragement they need to write the lyrics and perform their song.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Reiji, a man capable of completing any job flawlessly, is the Shining Agency's busiest idol. Haruka visits him between jobs to hold meetings with him. As they spend time alone together in his car and under gazebos at night, Haruka draws closer to his true nature hidden behind his smile...

tvdb.title: Never ...
tvdb.synopsis: Reiji takes a special liking to Haruka while Tokiya and Otoya feel overshadowed by his senior.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: As QUARTET NIGHT prepares for the Triple S opening artist screening concert, they head off on a trip with Haruka to work on their song. Shining Saotome's orders are to create a "number one song that will make them shine." However, the members of QUARTET NIGHT have never worked with a songwriter to compose a song before. With no precedent to lean on, what kind of song with they produce...?

tvdb.title: Answer
tvdb.synopsis: QUARTET★NIGHT and Haruka go on a trip to learn more about each other and write a song for Triple S. Haruka's kindness will inspire them to make a new song, they first they're able to make together.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: The Cross-Unit Projects concludes with great success. Though the international focus on them is growing, STARISH still hasn't received an answer regarding whether or not they'll be entered. When they hear the high quality of QUARTET NIGHT's new song, the anxiety they feel without Haruka peaks. However, the time they've spent together since the birth of STARISH leads them to a certain conclusion.

tvdb.title: Sankyu
tvdb.synopsis: ST☆RISH debates about what to do about Haruka since she's gotten close to QUARTET★NIGHT and they tell ST☆RISH they'll fight for keeping Haruka as their composer. As soon as she returns, they sing her a new song, "THANK YOU".

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: When Shining acknowledges STARISH's revolution when they spur QUARTET NIGHT into action, he allows them to enter the Triple S opening artist screening concert. Viewing STARISH as their greatest rivals, QUARTET NIGHT makes a request to Haruka in preparation for the concert.

tvdb.title: Evolution Eve
tvdb.synopsis: It's finally time for the Triple S concert, and QUARTET★NIGHT performs again (although in a longer and polished version) their song "Evolution Eve", leaving ST☆RISH, Haruka and the whole theater impressed.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: After QUARTET NIGHT's masterful performance, STARISH rushes onto the stage they've dreamed of performing on to challenge their rivals and deliver their voices to the world. Together the idol groups STARISH and QUARTET NIGHT have started a revolution of love, but an unexpected development waits for them in the final moments of the concert...

tvdb.title: Maji Love Revolutions
tvdb.synopsis: QUARTET★NIGHT and ST☆RISH fight for the entry song of the SSS competition. As soon as the judges are deciding which one of the two contestants will win, HE★VENS has their first debut since their defeat to ST☆RISH during the UtaPri Award, debuting now as a 7-member band. The battle continues on for the confirmed 4th season.
